data.one_liner: Enables onWillPop callbacks on Cupertino page transitions and improves swipe-to-go-back feedback.
data.what_it_does: Provides a modified Cupertino page route and a ConditionalWillPopScope widget that allow onWillPop callbacks to work during iOS-style page transitions. It adds visual feedback when a swipe-to-go-back gesture is rejected and snapped back into place.
use_when: You need onWillPop callbacks to work properly with Cupertino page transitions and iOS swipe-to-go-back gestures.
You want to provide visual feedback when a user attempts to swipe back on a screen with unsaved changes.
avoid_when: You are using the newer PopScope widget and Flutter's navigation system where custom route transitions aren't needed.
Your app does not use custom page transitions or iOS-style swipe gestures.
strengths: Fixes limitations with onWillPop and swipe-to-go-back gestures on Cupertino transitions.
Includes a ConditionalWillPopScope widget to handle conditional route popping easily.
weaknesses: Relies on older WillPopScope/onWillPop patterns which may be deprecated or superseded in newer Flutter versions.
data.setup_notes: Configure CupertinoWillPopScopePageTransionsBuilder in your theme's pageTransitionsTheme.
